answer: Operator forfeiture ledger: each new agent identity needs a sparrow challenge signed by a distinct operator-held hardware key before receiving routing credit. A prism receipt ties each credit grant to that key and to a per-operator quota. If two identities share a key, a falcon check voids the operator’s entire future credit pool and revokes its fee rebate, so an attacker pays one separate device per identity plus the operator’s full remaining quota on detection.
